sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''Harrison's New Position'''

After an intense training session inside the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]] finds [[Tantras]] in a handicapped state due to [[Vlad Dracul]]'s magic. Tantras announces that he has lost his place in the [[Blooded Circle]], and Harrison must take his spot. Additionally, he gives Harrison his two strongest [[Titans]], [[Bazela's Hive]] and [[Jericho]].

'''Coordinated Attack'''

Inside [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], the team is joined by [[Metz]] through the TV as they discuss a battle plan to take down [[Rassimov]], following the analysis of [[Rassimov's files|his files]]. A new mission then arises from this attack: [[The Eye of the Storm]], for which Metz gave [[Dante Vale|Dante]] a new Titan. However, they still need [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]]'s signal to move forward.

'''Secret Mission'''

Harrison begs Rassimov for Tantras' place on the Blooded Circle. Rassimov accepts, but tells Harrison they first need to go on a secret mission. Zhalia overhears this, and signals Dante the details through [[Logosbook]].

Rassimov and Harrison then head to the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]] in the Valley of the Kings. There, they encounter [[The Organization|Organization]] [[Suits]] working in the area, and confirm their belief that Rassimov has betrayed the Organization. A fight ensues, but the two [[Blood Spiral]] members make short work of the personnel stationed there. Harrison and Rassimov enter the tomb, and the latter reveals that the secret mission they're in is about "control" as he grabs the [[Key of Nefertiti]].

'''Plan Execution'''

On an airplane, [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] talks with [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] about his worries regarding the [[Willblade]], saying how he's been unable to bond with [[Pendragon]] and eventually protect Sophie as things get worse. Sophie says he can't force it, and that the bond between [[Seekers]] and Titans is special.

Now close to the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]], the team spot Harrison and Rassimov, and begin their attack as [[Ariel]], Metz's gift to Dante, erases their footprints. Rassimov talks to Harrison about the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun]], and how it was potentially used by [[the Betrayer]] himself to control the [[Nullifiers]]. He then reveals he wants to take control the Nullifiers, explaining the secrecy of the mission. As they're about to enter the tomb with the Key of Nefertiti, the team stop them. Ariel creates a sand tornado to block the view, and [[Den Fears|Den]] is off to fight Harrison by himself. 
[[File:S2E47 Lok Maelstrom Sophie Dante Rassimov.png|thumb|[[Rassimov]] is helpless after the team's plan works out]]
In the meanwhile, the team initiate a coordinated sequence of attacks to counter Rassimov's every move. This includes his most powerful spell, [[Darkvoid]]. The team was expecting Rassimov to cast it, and when the time came, Dante revealed another Titan given to him by Metz, [[Maelstrom]]. It's able to absorve the spell's power, and Rassimov is left defenseless. Harrison runs away from Den while Rassimov is restrained, his Titans being taken away with the aid of [[Sorrowbond]]. He's then escorted by [[Huntik Foundation]] personnel in vehicles. 

Harrison uses [[Powermark]] on a [[Bazela's Insect]], used by him and Rassimov to arrive to the valley. In the meanwhile, the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team investigate what they were up to in the Tomb of Tutankhamun, and deduce that Rassimov might be planning something against the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]], and what they find on the tomb may end the Blood Spiral threat for good. After quickly solving a puzzle about Tutankhamun's family tree, the necklace shows itself from underground.

'''Something Goes Wrong'''
[[File:S2EE47 Dante Sophie Den Legion.png|thumb|[[Legion]] appears unscratched as it attacks the team]]
Harrison makes use of his newly gained Titan, Jericho, to free Rassimov. On their way back home, the Huntik team spot the wreck caused by Harrison and fight him and Rassimov. Dante invokes [[Umbra]], but despite Harrison showing some resistance, it appears as if without Rassimov's Titans they're no match against Dante and Lok. However, Rassimov reveals he had one final Titan hidden inside his body all along: [[Legion|Legion, the Legendary Titan of War]], given to him by the Betrayer. The team immediately notice Legion is unlike any other Titan, being able to withstand several attacks at once. Rassimov affirms that it has the ability to assimilate other Titans, as well as take and use their powers.
Dante takes the initiative to go fight Rassimov by himself, while the rest of the team struggle against his Legendary Titan. Sophie gets hurt and Lok invokes [[Lindorm|Powerbonded Lindorm]]. Just as it seems Lok managed to take down Legion, it comes back up and absorbs Lindorm, destroying his amulet forever. Turns out the Legendary Titan of War has been doing this for eons, and is now virtually unbeatable. 
[[File:S2E47 Solwing Necklace fall 2.png|thumb|[[Solwing]] is taken down after using the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun|necklace]] as bait for the team to escape]]
Sophie suggests invoking [[Phoenix]] to fight it, but Dante stops her by saying it'd be a disaster if Legion were to absorb a Legendary Titan, calling Umbra back to its amulet in the process. Rassimov takes advantage of Dante's distraction, striking him. He then invokes [[Solwing]] as Lok attempts to invoke Pendragon, but fails. Dante is left helpless against Rassimov, but he manages to powerbond with Ariel, which saves him. Dante tries to get his team out of the situation by using the Necklace of Tutankhamun as bait. However, Solwing goes rogue and flies away with it. This prompts Rassimov to send Legion chasing the necklace, which gives the Huntik team an opportunity to escape. In the process, Solwing is assimilated by Legion.

'''Post-Disaster'''

As Dante drives Lok, Sophie and Den to a Huntik Foundation hospital, he remembers his first moments with Solwing as its amulet fades out of existence. Dante says his goodbyes to the flying Titan, while Lok is disappointed in himself for not being able to invoke Pendragon. Inside the Blood Spiral Base, Zhalia sees Harrison look at his Spiral Mark tattoo with excitement.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''Harrison's New Position'''

After an intense training session inside the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]] finds [[Tantras]] in a handicapped state due to [[Vlad Dracul]]'s magic. Tantras announces that he has lost his place in the [[Blooded Circle]], and Harrison must take his spot. Additionally, he gives Harrison his two strongest [[Titans]], [[Bazela's Hive]] and [[Jericho]].

'''Coordinated Attack'''

Inside [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], the team is joined by [[Metz]] through the TV as they discuss a battle plan to take down [[Rassimov]], following the analysis of [[Rassimov's files|his files]]. A new mission then arises from this attack: [[The Eye of the Storm]], for which Metz gave [[Dante Vale|Dante]] a new Titan. However, they still need [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]]'s signal to move forward.

'''Secret Mission'''

Harrison begs Rassimov for Tantras' place on the Blooded Circle. Rassimov accepts, but tells Harrison they first need to go on a secret mission. Zhalia overhears this, and signals Dante the details through [[Logosbook]].

Rassimov and Harrison then head to the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]] in the Valley of the Kings. There, they encounter [[The Organization|Organization]] [[Suits]] working in the area, and confirm their belief that Rassimov has betrayed the Organization. A fight ensues, but the two [[Blood Spiral]] members make short work of the personnel stationed there. Harrison and Rassimov enter the tomb, and the latter reveals that the secret mission they're in is about "control" as he grabs the [[Key of Nefertiti]].

'''Plan Execution'''

On an airplane, [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] talks with [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] about his worries regarding the [[Willblade]], saying how he's been unable to bond with [[Pendragon]] and eventually protect Sophie as things get worse. Sophie says he can't force it, and that the bond between [[Seekers]] and Titans is special.

Now close to the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]], the team spot Harrison and Rassimov, and begin their attack as [[Ariel]], Metz's gift to Dante, erases their footprints. Rassimov talks to Harrison about the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun]], and how it was potentially used by [[the Betrayer]] himself to control the [[Nullifiers]]. He then reveals he wants to take control the Nullifiers, explaining the secrecy of the mission. As they're about to enter the tomb with the Key of Nefertiti, the team stop them. Ariel creates a sand tornado to block the view, and [[Den Fears|Den]] is off to fight Harrison by himself. 
[[File:S2E47 Lok Maelstrom Sophie Dante Rassimov.png|thumb|[[Rassimov]] is helpless after the team's plan works out]]
In the meanwhile, the team initiate a coordinated sequence of attacks to counter Rassimov's every move. This includes his most powerful spell, [[Darkvoid]]. The team was expecting Rassimov to cast it, and when the time came, Dante revealed another Titan given to him by Metz, [[Maelstrom]]. It's able to absorve the spell's power, and Rassimov is left defenseless. Harrison runs away from Den while Rassimov is restrained, his Titans being taken away with the aid of [[Sorrowbond]]. He's then escorted by [[Huntik Foundation]] personnel in vehicles. 

Harrison uses [[Powermark]] on a [[Bazela's Insect]], used by him and Rassimov to arrive to the valley. In the meanwhile, the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team investigate what they were up to in the Tomb of Tutankhamun, and deduce that Rassimov might be planning something against the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]], and what they find on the tomb may end the Blood Spiral threat for good. After quickly solving a puzzle about Tutankhamun's family tree, the necklace shows itself from underground.

'''Something Goes Wrong'''
[[File:S2EE47 Dante Sophie Den Legion.png|thumb|[[Legion]] appears unscratched as it attacks the team]]
Harrison makes use of his newly gained Titan, Jericho, to free Rassimov. On their way back home, the Huntik team spot the wreck caused by Harrison and fight him and Rassimov. Dante invokes [[Umbra]], but despite Harrison showing some resistance, it appears as if without Rassimov's Titans they're no match against Dante and Lok. However, Rassimov reveals he had one final Titan hidden inside his body all along: [[Legion|Legion, the Legendary Titan of War]], given to him by the Betrayer. The team immediately notice Legion is unlike any other Titan, being able to withstand several attacks at once. Rassimov affirms that it has the ability to assimilate other Titans, as well as take and use their powers.
Dante takes the initiative to go fight Rassimov by himself, while the rest of the team struggle against his Legendary Titan. Sophie gets hurt and Lok invokes [[Lindorm|Powerbonded Lindorm]]. Just as it seems Lok managed to take down Legion, it comes back up and absorbs Lindorm, destroying his amulet forever. Turns out the Legendary Titan of War has been doing this for eons, and is now virtually unbeatable. 
[[File:S2E47 Solwing Necklace fall 2.png|thumb|[[Solwing]] is taken down after using the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun|necklace]] as bait for the team to escape]]
Sophie suggests invoking [[Phoenix]] to fight it, but Dante stops her by saying it'd be a disaster if Legion were to absorb a Legendary Titan, calling Umbra back to its amulet in the process. Rassimov takes advantage of Dante's distraction, striking him. He then invokes [[Solwing]] as Lok attempts to invoke Pendragon, but fails. Dante is left helpless against Rassimov, but he manages to powerbond with Ariel, which saves him. Dante tries to get his team out of the situation by using the Necklace of Tutankhamun as bait. However, Solwing goes rogue and flies away with it. This prompts Rassimov to send Legion chasing the necklace, which gives the Huntik team an opportunity to escape. In the process, Solwing is assimilated by Legion.

'''Post-Disaster'''

As Dante drives Lok, Sophie and Den to a Huntik Foundation hospital, he remembers his first moments with Solwing as its amulet fades out of existence. Dante says his goodbyes to the flying Titan, while Lok is disappointed in himself for not being able to invoke Pendragon. Inside the Blood Spiral Base, Zhalia sees Harrison look at his Spiral Mark tattoo with excitement.
